observations.result: The imported analysis for the initial synthetic report classified accessibility, contact and responsive as missing. Its exact quotations say accessibility was pending, contact submission was not tested, and responsive was checked only at 375 pixels. The response was validated before v2 was saved. There is no dedicated screenshot of the v1 result cards.
The corrected synthetic sample was saved as evidence version v2; the prior v1 JSON was rejected with AI_REVIEW_STALE.

A newly generated response for the v2 fingerprint was imported. The interface reported version and quotation validation, three evidence_found findings, zero missing and zero unclear. This supports only exact passages in the supplied synthetic report and does not verify the underlying work.

A separate local review session recorded three criterion checks plus overall acknowledgement, after which the current saved version was displayed as accepted. The local capability does not authenticate a real customer.

The merchant explicitly confirmed a simulated draft. The interface showed mock identifier INV2-MOCK-0001 and a subsequent local read-back of the simulated record, still associated with the accepted v2.

Before save, the unsaved edit warning said saved v2 still governed. After saving v3, the previously verified simulated draft remained traceable as belonging to the previous version, and the current version required a new review. The button yielded CURRENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED, also verified in the displayed DOM.

separate_paypal_sandbox_evidence.description: A different one-shot GitHub Actions core-adapter run authenticated with PayPal Sandbox, created an unsent synthetic draft, and directly read it back. It was not triggered by the browser simulator click and did not reuse this UI state.
